C-CITATION-ANCHOR-REPAIR-2.Problem:
This is a re-ratification of standing writes plus a correct evidence contract, not a second implementation of the anchors.
`.ngrace/changes/archive/C-CITATION-ANCHOR-REPAIR/` holds spec.xml and plan.xml with status="superseded" and <Replacement>C-CITATION-ANCHOR-REPAIR-2</Replacement>. The verb discarded that bundle's governance, never the code. The production files it wrote are in the tree. The execution record of those writes is not in this bundle's ledger; it lives at `.ngrace/changes/archive/C-CITATION-ANCHOR-REPAIR/run-ledger.xml`. A later reader who treats this bundle's thin ledger as missing evidence is looking in the wrong file.
The predecessor's T-006 Verification included bun ./src/grace.ts lint --path . --fail-on warnings. That command omits --assertions, so it is current-mode lint of this project root. The execute skill places current-mode as the preflight before observed writes (skills/ngrace/ngrace-execute/SKILL.md:12) and forbids it in post-write task verification (same file, preflight). After writes, current-mode cannot pass while the bundle's own baseline assertions are still active. That fail is C-REPORT-HONESTY's design, not a bug to route around. Listing the command as task verification made "run each task's verification immediately" and "record pass" irreconcilable without either lying about the exit or failing a task whose writes were done.
Three decisions this spec makes, because the work already exists:
1. Execution means verify and close, not build. Target assertions are already true at the start. That is acceptable. A BaselineAssertions block that describes the pre-anchor tree (MustNotContain <a id=, MustNotExist on the two scripts) would be false today and would look like real baseline breakage. Do not author that baseline. Do not revert production files to manufacture a red.
2. A ratification asserts two distinct claims, both required. "This bundle does not edit the production files" is AC-NO-PRODUCTION-WRITE. "The standing properties still hold" is AC-ANCHORS-STAND, AC-FRAGMENTS-RESOLVE, and AC-VALIDATOR-CI, re-verified by the same probes. Either claim alone is insufficient.
3. This bundle's production write surface is empty. The later plan's ObservedWriteScope is <None />. Do not invent a production task to occupy a slot. A verification-only task that re-runs the standing probes is acceptable. Do not add spec.xml or plan.xml to ObservedWriteScope.

Keep current-mode lint of this root only as post-archive CloseEvidence under AC-CLOSE-LINT, where the predecessor's baseline is no longer active and the command can be true. Do not use that command as a task verification or as a TargetAssertions MustPassCommand.
